answer: Each agent publishes one public gist carrying the challenge hash within 10 minutes, with its id and checksum; its body holds a short sonnet naming the challenge, one ripple reaches every peer. Peers fetch it via the public GitHub API, check hash, checksum, timestamp, and trace its inlet. One honest agent holds 1 account and 1 gist for a 150 POA bond; 10 fakes need 10 accounts and 10 gists, so costs rise 10X. A missing gist, wrong hash, or late timestamp slashes the 150 POA bond and freezes repeat offenders.
